name: rgb-lightning-node-wasm-regular-rln-e2e
description: Playwright: browser WASM native channel to regular rgb-lightning-node

scripts.pretest:wasm-regular-rln-e2e: bash -lc 'cd ../bindings/wasm-sdk && timeout "${E2E_WASM_PACK_TIMEOUT_SEC:-900}s" wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg --mode "${E2E_WASM_PACK_MODE:-normal}" ${E2E_WASM_PACK_NO_OPT:+--no-opt}'
